description: E-mail security audit of a domain: MX, SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI, grade. One call audits a domain's mail setup: MX + provider, SPF tree and lookup count, DMARC policy, DKIM keys at common selectors, MTA-STS record and policy file, TLS-RPT, BIMI. Returns a 0-100 score, a letter grade and a prioritized list of fixes. Price: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
